resources.string: CLIMB 1600 uses this accessibility service solely to detect when user-configured distracting apps are opened during active study sessions, and to show a gentle pause screen reminding you of your active Codeforces problem. It never inspects passwords, banking data, or private messages.
CLIMB 1600 uses a local on-device filter to block user-selected distracting websites during study sessions. No internet traffic is decrypted or sent to external servers.
